grid=[[1,0,0,1,0,0],[0]*6,[3,0,0,1,0,0]]
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Encode each T motif by orientation in a coarse 3x6 spatial map.
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    R=len(grid); C=len(grid[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(R):
      for c in range(C):
        if grid[r][c]!=2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            p=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=p[0]<R and 0<=p[1]<C and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==2 and p not in seen:
              seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
        if len(comp)!=4: continue
        ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        y0,y1=min(ys),max(ys); x0,x1=min(xs),max(xs)
        stem=3 if sum(1 for x in range(x0,x1+1) if (y0,x) in comp)==1 and y0<y1 else 1
        rr=0 if (y0+y1)/2 < R/2 else 2
        cc=0 if (x0+x1)/2 < C/2 else 3
        out[rr][cc]=stem
    return out
'''
